# Operations

## Plants
Four manufacturing sites. Blended OEE across the network is ~**70%** against an **85% target**.

| plant | location | products | headcount | plant manager | OEE |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Rockford (HQ) | Rockford, IL | pumps + final assembly | ~520 | [Bob Petrakis](../people/bob-petrakis.md) | **71%** |
| Toledo | Toledo, OH | industrial valves | ~180 | [Miguel Herrera](../people/miguel-herrera.md) | **63%** |
| Greenville | Greenville, SC | hydraulic power units (HPUs) | ~380 | **VACANT** (was [Karen Diaz](../people/karen-diaz.md)) | **68%** |
| Monterrey | Monterrey, MX | castings finishing + machining | ~320 | Elena Ruiz (not a direct report of Ray's) | **74%** |

- Rockford and Toledo are **USW-represented**; Greenville and Monterrey are non-union.
- Toledo is the oldest and lowest-OEE site and is under strategic review — see confidential
  [Slate](../projects/slate.md).

## Capacity & demand
- Order backlog ~**$88M**; lead times stretched on HPUs (Greenville) to ~14 weeks.
- The [HydraForce capacity expansion](../projects/hydraforce-capacity-expansion.md) adds a second
  HPU assembly cell at Greenville to pull lead time back toward 8 weeks.

## Supply chain
- **Ductile-iron castings** are the critical input for pumps and valves and are effectively
  **single-sourced** from [Cascade Castings](../people/bob-nguyen.md) (contact:
  Bob Nguyen). Casting lead time (~11 weeks) is the binding constraint on the
  [HydraFlow line launch](../projects/hydraflow-line-launch.md).
- Electric motors, seals, and fasteners are multi-sourced and not a current risk.

## Safety / OSHA
- **TRIR** (total recordable incident rate) is **3.1**, against a target of **< 2.0**.
- A **recordable amputation-risk incident at Rockford** (lockout/tagout failure, March 2026)
  drew an **OSHA citation**; corrective action is tracked under
  [safety remediation](../projects/safety-remediation.md). EHS lead is
  [Linda Fowler](../people/linda-fowler.md).

## Core KPIs (2026 targets vs. actuals)
| KPI | target | current |
|---|---|---|
| Blended OEE | 85% | ~70% |
| On-time delivery (OTD) | 96% | 91% |
| Scrap rate | < 2.5% | 3.8% |
| TRIR (safety) | < 2.0 | 3.1 |
| EBITDA margin | 13% | ~9% |
